exam.title: Microsoft Identity and Access Administrator
exam.study_prerequisites: Practical Microsoft Entra ID, Azure, Microsoft 365 and AD DS experience plus PowerShell and KQL; hands-on identity lifecycle, strong authentication, Conditional Access, hybrid identity, enterprise applications, workload identities, governance, privileged access, and monitoring experience is strongly recommended.

review.notes: Every subobjective in the April 27, 2026 blueprint is mapped to an identity lifecycle, delegation decision, authentication/authorization boundary, configuration dependency, evidence artifact, failure action, or recovery path. Three integrated scenarios, eight independent labs, and 36 original checks cover tenant roles/AUs/settings, workforce/device/license and custom-attribute lifecycle, external/cross-tenant and hybrid identity, strong authentication/TAP/passkeys/SSPR/Hello, Conditional Access/risk/Global Secure Access, managed and application identities, enterprise apps/App Proxy/consent, Defender for Cloud Apps, entitlement/access reviews/PIM/emergency access, logs/KQL/workbooks and Identity Secure Score. All 45 cited URLs are exact catalog entries: 43 were reachable and two O'Reilly book pages returned access-blocked HTTP 403; none was missing or broken. The guide verifies the active exam and free Practice Assessment, records 15 hours 11 minutes of current Learn paths, labels older books/videos by their current gaps, marks Cloud Sync/GSA/registration/MDCA transitions for re-verification, and discloses Microsoft's conflicting authentication-domain weight. No upcoming blueprint change or retirement was announced.
